issues.quote: cash and cash equivalents rose to $16.5 million from $16.1 billion
issues.problem: Unit error: the figure should be $16.5 billion, not $16.5 million. As written, it would mean cash collapsed rather than rose.

data.summary: Most figures look right and the percentages work out. One mistake: the cash figure is labeled as $16.5 million when it should be $16.5 billion.
